TEXT:
After having some tea at the cafe, Ayase took me 
to a park by the sea.

Although I thought we'd go to another shop to 
have lunch...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Good thing we found some empty benches. Let's 
have a break here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Say, Ayase?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
There doesn't seem to be any shops around here, 
so what do we do about lunch?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Oh, that...

Ayase puffed her chest out slightly and presented 
me with the basket she'd been carrying.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Please open it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh? Okay... [font_size=33]Whoa![/font_size]

Inside the basket were tidily packed sandwiches 
and various side dishes.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Help yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Okay, I'm digging in!
I grabbed a sandwich and bit into it.
D-Delicious...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Did... Did you make these?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Of course. Well, I did receive a bit of my mother's 
help though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Still, this is great!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Really? Ah, let me take out the chopsticks.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sure.

I received the chopsticks from Ayase and reached 
for the side dishes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [font_size=28]Gnrk![/font_size] *cough*

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Ah, geez. There's no need to rush. Here, have some 
tea.

As I was choking, I took the thermos with tea from 
Ayase and drank from it to clear my throat of fried 
food.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Sorry. It was just so delicious I couldn't help 
myself.

Not only that, but I was also very happy that Ayase 
would go as far as making my lunch.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Oh, I know.

Upon seeing my reaction, Ayase seemed to have 
thought of something as she clapped her hands 
together.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Onii-san... Say ah~

Ayase took out a piece of fried egg with her 
chopsticks and brought it towards my mouth.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? What?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I-I'm telling you, just say ah~, Onii-san...

As Ayase looked more flustered than moments ago, 
I couldn't help but stare blankly at her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: H-Hey?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
This way, you won't end up choking again because 
you're rushing, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I probably won't, but...
That's just too damn embarrassing!

Without thinking, I made sure there were no 
spectators watching us.
I bet my face is turning bright red right about now.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Geez, hurry up already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: O-Okay.

I swallowed hard and hesitantly started opening my 
mouth.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Okay, say ah~

Ayase moved the fried egg towards me with a 
sweet smile on her face.

There's probably some sugar added, there's a 
sweet taste to it...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: H-How is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Delicious.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: T-Then, next is...

Whether she was happy with my reaction, Ayase 
looked like she was having fun as she fed me more, 
one piece at a time.

Sure, this is incredibly embarrassing, but I felt a 
broad smile settling on my face.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Phew, that was good. Thanks for the food!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: You're welcome.

Ayase happily responded as she started putting 
everything away.

That's when my gaze suddenly landed on Ayase's 
lap. Stomach now full, it's only natural to feel sleepy.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: What is it, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, nothing...

If I asked for this, would she call me a pervert 
again? Still, we're dating, so just a little...
Bah, whatever!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...S-Say, could I use your lap as a pillow?
